product.description: Monoprice™Multi‑Mode OM4 Fiber Optic Cable ‑ MTP®‑12 UPC Femaleto MTP‑12 UPC Female 12‑Fiber OFNP Type‑A AquaOptimized for 40G and 100G Systems Requiring Reliable, High‑Bandwidth ConnectivityExperience next‑level high‑speed data connectivity with our Multi‑Mode OM4 Fiber Optic Cable ‑ MTP‑12 UPC Female to MTP‑12 UPC Female. Engineered for mission‑critical network environments, this 12‑fiber cable features OM4 laser‑optimized multimode fiber, delivering superior bandwidth and performance over short to medium distances‑ideal for data centers, enterprise networks, and SAN (storage area network) applications.Designed with MTP UPC connectors, this cable ensures low insertion loss and optimal optical signal transmission. The UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) polished ferrules provide superior return loss, minimizing signal degradation and ensuring exceptional reliability across 40G/100G Ethernet deployments and high‑density backbone networks.With a Type‑A polarity configuration, this cable provides a straight‑through fiber mapping solution, ensuring compatibility with parallel optics systems and transceivers. Its compact 12‑fiber design supports plug‑and‑play modularity, significantly reducing cable congestion and improving airflow in high‑density rack environments.The OFNP (Plenum‑rated) jacket complies with the highest fire safety standards, making it suitable for installation in air‑handling spaces such as ceiling ducts and raised floors. Built to withstand demanding conditions, this cable maintains excellent performance under mechanical stress and repeated connections.Whether you're upgrading an existing infrastructure or building a new high‑speed backbone, the MTP‑12 OM4 solution offers high performance, scalability, and cost‑efficiency in a streamlined design. Backed by quality construction and tested to exceed industry standards, it's the perfect choice for future‑ready fiber networks.MTP‑12 Elite UPC female connectorsHigh‑performance OM4 multimode
